description: Land Acquisition - Werahera, Kesbewa D/S Division, Colombo District
reasoning: This gazette notice is a formal declaration under the Land Acquisition Act for the government's intention to acquire specific parcels of land (118 allotments totaling 33.9827 hectares) to create a water reserve. The content is exclusively focused on land acquisition matters, including detailed descriptions of individual land plots, their locations, extents, and claimants. This fits precisely within the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) which covers "land acquisitions, transfers, or disposals" and "any gazette content primarily dealing with land, property, or real estate matters."
